name: Windows NetBIOS Name Release on Demand Ignored
description:
Ensures the computer ignores NetBIOS name release requests except from WINS servers (NoNameReleaseOnDemand = 1).
Required Windows permission (remedy only): the LEA agent account must be allowed to run reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters" /v NoNameReleaseOnDemand (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

_remedy.command: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters" /v NoNameReleaseOnDemand /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f | Out-Null; reg query "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters" /v NoNameReleaseOnDemand
